####################################################################################################
Purpose: To unzip the folders with the data frames of each study and save them as rds.

Data:
The working copy of the studies (unzipped and organized):
- in the bg/gsk_data folder 
The working copy of the vacc_con files of some studies (unzipped):
- in the bg/vacc_con_data folder 

Output:
For each study folder and the vacc_con folder, the unziped, rds files from the data frames. 
####################################################################################################

# Set the working directory to the project directory
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Nextcloud/Projects/_seas_imm/code_exp_imm')
```

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
source("00_pck.R")
library(haven)
```

# Get the list of zipped and unzipped study files
```{r}
# List all study folders
studies_folders <- sapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}")), simplify = FALSE,
                          function(x) list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{x}")))

# Identify already unzipped study folders (at the moment, all unzipped)
unziped_studies <- list()
for (pat in names(studies_folders)) {
  for (stu in studies_folders[[pat]]) {
    if(any(str_detect(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}")), ".rds")) == TRUE) {
      unziped_studies[[pat]] <- c(unziped_studies[[pat]], stu) }
  }}

# Identify zipped study folders
ziped_studies <- lapply(studies_folders, function(x) {
  x[!(x %in% unlist(unziped_studies))]
})

ziped_studies
```

# Unzip folders with study data frames and save the data frames as RDS
Note: Run only once. SAS files cannot be reopened after being saved.
```{r}
# Unzip study folders
for (pat in names(ziped_studies)) {
  for (stu in ziped_studies[[pat]]) {
    study.mod <- str_replace_all(stu, "-", "_")
    study.folders <- list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}"))
    study.zip <- study.folders[str_detect(study.folders,"zip")]
    unzip(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{study.zip}"),
      exdir = glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}"))
}}

# Open the data frames and convert to RDS format
for (pat in names(ziped_studies)) {
  for (stu in ziped_studies[[pat]]) {
    study.mod <- str_replace_all(stu, "-", "_")
    study.folder <- list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}"))
    study.dfolder <- list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}"))
    study.dfolder <- study.dfolder[!str_detect(study.dfolder,"zip")]
    study.dfolder <- study.dfolder[str_detect(study.dfolder,"Datasets|CSV|datasets")]
    study.exp.file <- list.files(
      glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{study.dfolder}"))
    # Process SAS files
    for (doc in study.exp.file) {
      if(str_detect(doc, "sas") == T) {
        doc.new <- str_replace(doc,".sas7bdat",".rds")
        read_sas(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{study.dfolder}/{doc}")) %>%
          saveRDS(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{doc.new}"))
      } else
    # Process CSV files
      if(str_detect(doc, "sas") != T) {
        doc.new <- str_replace(doc,".csv",".rds")
        read.csv(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{study.dfolder}/{doc}")) %>%
          saveRDS(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{doc.new}"))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# Verify the number of unzipped files matches the number of new RDS files
```{r}
allrds <- data.frame(pathogen = character(), study = character(), n_same = logical())
for (pat in names(studies_folders)) {
  for (stu in studies_folders[[pat]]) {
    study.folder <- str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}")), "zip", negate = T)
    study.zip <- list.files(
      glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}/{str_subset(study.folder, 'Datasets|CSV|datasets')}")) %>%
      str_remove(".sas7bdat|.csv")
    study.rds <- str_subset(study.folder, "rds") %>%
      str_remove(".rds")
    allrds <- rbind(allrds, data.frame(pathogen = pat, study = stu, 
                                       n_same = all(study.zip == study.rds)))
}}
all(allrds$n_same)
```

# Save the data frames from vacc_con folder as RDS
Note: Run only once. SAS files cannot be reopened after being saved.
These data frames with concomitant vaccines where obtained at a later point and, therefore, sent 
separately for some studies. They are unzipped and moved into the corresponding study folder.
```{r}
# Convert vacc_con files to RDS format
for (vacc_con in list.files(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/gsk_vacc_con datasets/"))) {
  if(!file.exists(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/{str_replace(vacc_con,'.sas7bdat|.csv','.rds')}"))) {
    # Process SAS files
    if(str_detect(vacc_con, "sas") == T) {
      vacc_con.new <- str_replace(vacc_con,".sas7bdat",".rds")
      read_sas(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/gsk_vacc_con datasets/{vacc_con}")) %>%
        saveRDS(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/{vacc_con.new}"))
    } else
    # Process CSV files
    if(str_detect(vacc_con, "csv") == T) {
      vacc_con.new <- str_replace(vacc_con,".csv",".rds")
      read.csv(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/gsk_vacc_con datasets/{vacc_con}")) %>%
        saveRDS(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}/{vacc_con.new}"))
    }
  }    
}
```
